existing_features.title: Create a complete multi-page marketing site inspired by the provided ThemeForest preview (Renev modern creative digital agency), including global navigation, footer, and consistent layout across all pages.

Implement the core pages and sections commonly present in the Renev-style agency template: Home (hero + key sections), About, Services (list + detail views), Portfolio/Case Studies (grid + detail), Blog/Insights (list + detail), and Contact (form + company info).

Define and apply one coherent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, buttons, cards, section styling) matching a modern creative digital agency aesthetic; keep it consistent across the entire site.

Add modern UI interactions similar to the preview: active nav state, smooth anchor scrolling for section links, hover/press states on cards/buttons, and subtle scroll-reveal animations for major sections.
Implement a working Contact form that submits to the Internet Computer backend and shows success/error states to the user.
Provide basic SEO and accessibility fundamentals: semantic headings, alt text for images, keyboard-navigable menus, and page-level meta title/description per route.

Add a small set of reusable content/data structures in the frontend (e.g., arrays for services, portfolio items, blog posts, testimonials) to drive the UI consistently across list/detail pages without hardcoding in multiple places.

Render the generated static images as local assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them throughout the site (hero visuals, portfolio thumbnails, team/testimonial avatars, and brand/shape accents).

Implement a single-page Home (front page) experience only (no additional routes/pages), inspired by the Renev modern creative digital agency style, with a cohesive section-based layout (e.g., Hero, About snapshot, Services overview, Featured work/Portfolio highlights, Testimonials, Metrics/Stats, CTA, Footer).
Add an on-page navigation header for the Home page that uses anchor links to scroll to sections on the same page (single-page navigation).

Define and apply one coherent visual theme for the Home page (colors, typography, spacing, buttons, cards, and section styling) matching a modern creative digital agency aesthetic, and keep it consistent across all Home sections.
Add modern UI interactions on the Home page: hover/press states for interactive elements and subtle scroll-reveal animations for major sections as they enter the viewport.

Drive the Home page sections from a small set of reusable frontend content data structures (e.g., arrays/objects for services, featured projects, testimonials, stats) to avoid duplicative hardcoding across the page.
Provide basic SEO and accessibility fundamentals for the single Home page: semantic heading structure, alt text for images, and page-level meta title/description for the Home route.

Add and render locally generated static images for the Home page under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the Hero and other key Home sections (e.g., featured work thumbnails and testimonial avatars).
